name: GL_XFR_PSFT_STATUS_GT
description: GL_XFR_PSFT_STATUS_GT is a temporary table used by the Peoplesoft Transform and Import program to record interim data.  For each Peoplesoft business unit and ledger combination, it stores the associated fusion ledger name and id, the associated chart of accounts mapping name, id, and to chart of accounts, the status of the run, the number of journals and lines processed, the default values to be used for each segment, and the group id and request id used by Journal Import.

columns.name: PEOPLESOFT_BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME
columns.description: Peoplesoft business unit name

columns.name: PEOPLESOFT_LEDGER_NAME
columns.description: Peoplesoft ledger id

columns.name: FUSION_LEDGER_NAME
columns.description: Fusion ledger name

columns.name: FUSION_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Fusion ledger id

columns.name: COA_MAPPING_NAME
columns.description: Chart of accounts mapping name

columns.name: COA_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts mapping id

columns.name: COA_MAP_TO_COA_NAME
columns.description: To chart of accounts of the chart of accounts mapping

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Run status

columns.name: JOURNAL_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Peoplesoft journals processed by run

columns.name: LINE_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Peoplesoft lines processed by run

columns.name: CHECK_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Does period information need to be validated

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Journal import group id

columns.name: JOURNAL_IMPORT_REQUEST_ID
